For the 175B SFT model, the paper uses a **learning rate of 5.03e-6, a batch size of 8, and 16 epochs**.

**Learning rate and batch size**
- The 175B model uses a learning rate of 5.03e-6 and a batch size of 8. (The 1.3B and 6B models instead use 9.65e-6 and 32.) (p. 40)
- The schedule is cosine decay down to 10% of the original learning rate, with no warmup. (p. 40)
- The learning rate was chosen by a geometric search over 5 values for the 175B model. (p. 40)

**Epochs**
- The SFT models were trained for 16 epochs with residual dropout of 0.2. (p. 8, p. 40)
- The number of epochs was also tuned by geometric search. (p. 40)
- The SFT models overfit on validation loss after 1 epoch. However, training longer still improved RM score and human preference ratings. (p. 8)
- Final models were selected by RM score, which the authors found predicts human preference better than validation loss. (p. 8, p. 41)

**Related but different model**
The models used to initialize RLHF (PPO) are trained differently from the SFT baseline. The 175B initialization model is trained for 2 epochs with a learning rate of 2.45e-6 and a batch size of 8, mixing in 10% pretraining data. (p. 42)
